meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把分叉代码升级到上游版本并保留自定义修改
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你维护上游项目的分叉,想在不丢失自定义改动的前提下完成升级。
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade your fork to upstream while keeping your custom changes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork and want to upgrade without losing your custom changes.

howto.what: 这个技能会分析你对 NanoClaw 仓库做的本地改动,生成一份可重复执行的 Markdown 迁移指南,记录改动意图和具体做法;升级时先拉取干净的上游代码,再按指南重新应用这些改动,避免 git merge 冲突。
howto.when: 当你需要对一个改动过的 NanoClaw 仓库升级到上游新版本、想避免 git 合并冲突时触发;如果迁移指南已存在,会先询问是否直接跳到升级阶段。

say.text: 帮我把这个 NanoClaw 仓库的本地改动整理成迁移指南
say.note: 它会先检查工作区,分析改动并生成指南。

say.text: 我已经有迁移指南了,直接按它升级到上游最新版
say.note: 它会跳过提取阶段,直接进入升级。

say.text: 这次改动涉及多个技能,按完整流程迁移吧
say.note: 它会用子代理并行排查改动并制定迁移计划。

howto.what_en: Extracts customizations from a NanoClaw fork into a replayable Markdown guide with intent and implementation details. On upgrade, reapplies them onto clean upstream via a worktree, avoiding merge conflicts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to upgrade a customized NanoClaw fork to the latest upstream without merge conflicts. If a migration guide already exists, offers to skip straight to the upgrade phase.

say_en.text: Create a migration guide for the local changes in this NanoClaw repo.
say_en.note: It will check the working tree and generate the guide.

say_en.text: I already have a migration guide — upgrade to latest upstream using it.
say_en.note: It skips extraction and goes straight to upgrade.

say_en.text: This involves multiple applied skills; run the full migration process.
say_en.note: It uses sub-agents to explore changes and build a plan.
